title: ambi_decode3
description: `ambi_decode3` calculates a higher-order Ambisonics decoder matrix for real loudspeaker layouts, supporting up to 12th-order 2D or 5th-order 3D decoding and optional phantom loudspeakers. Its four creation arguments specify Ambisonic order, dimension, number of real loudspeakers, and number of phantom loudspeakers; after defining their positions, `begin_pseudo_inverse` calculates the pseudoinverse and `end_pseudo_inverse` outputs the real-speaker portion as a `matrix` message.
